description: Default configuration for Indian telecom customer service analysis. Covers TRAI regulations, standard quality criteria, and common risk scenarios.

compliance_policies.name: DND Compliance
compliance_policies.description: Agents must not make unsolicited commercial/marketing calls to customers registered on the NCPR/DND registry. Any promotional offer must only be communicated if the customer has opted in.

compliance_policies.name: Explicit Consent for Changes
compliance_policies.description: Agent must obtain clear, explicit verbal consent from the customer before activating, deactivating, or modifying any plan, addon, or service. Silence or ambiguity does not constitute consent.

compliance_policies.name: Tariff Transparency
compliance_policies.description: Agent must clearly communicate all charges, fees, taxes, and billing cycle implications before making any plan or service change. No hidden charges allowed.

compliance_policies.name: Complaint Acknowledgment
compliance_policies.description: When a customer files a complaint, the agent must provide a docket/complaint reference number and inform about expected resolution timeline as per TRAI guidelines.

compliance_policies.name: MNP Rights Information
compliance_policies.description: Agent must not provide false, misleading, or discouraging information regarding Mobile Number Portability (MNP). Customer's right to port must be respected.

compliance_policies.name: Data Privacy
compliance_policies.description: Agent must not request or disclose sensitive personal information (Aadhaar, full bank details) unless absolutely necessary for identity verification, and must inform the customer why the information is needed.

compliance_policies.name: Call Recording Disclosure
compliance_policies.description: Customer must be informed that the call is being recorded for quality and training purposes.
